run_subprocess_with_logging: run a shell command as a subprocess with optional output logging to a file
run_python_script: run a python script as a subprocess with optional arguments and output capture
validate_env_vars: validate that required environment variables are set before running a pipeline script
setup_pipeline_env: setup common environment variables for a dataset pipeline using the dataset name
validate_white_balance: validate a white balance string format and return a default if the format is invalid
